summary: This PR replaces the `Greeting` composable with `Quiz`. `Quiz` shows a title and 10 placeholder question rows in a `LazyColumn`, and the preview is updated to match. Nothing else in the repo still uses `Greeting`. `items(10)` is part of `LazyListScope`, so it needs no extra import. The closing brace of `MainActivity` has extra indentation now, but the class still closes correctly. I found no bugs or crashes.
